# Support

Looking for help? Pick the channel that matches the question. The right one usually gets you a faster, more useful answer.

## Documentation

Start with the [README](../README.md) and the [`apps/docs/`](../apps/docs) site — most "how do I…?" questions are already covered there.

If you find something wrong or missing, open a [documentation issue](https://github.com/tortuvshin/grove/issues/new?template=documentation.md). Docs PRs are very welcome.

## Community help (questions, how-tos, "is this normal?")

- **GitHub Discussions** — best for open-ended questions, design discussion, and "how would you model this in a Grove space?" The maintainers read all of them.
- **GitHub Issues** — for a specific bug, feature, or docs problem. Use the [question template](https://github.com/tortuvshin/grove/issues/new?template=question.md) if the answer isn't a yes/no.

Please don't DM the maintainers for support questions — public threads help the next person with the same problem.

## Bugs and feature requests

- **Bug** → [bug report](https://github.com/tortuvshin/grove/issues/new?template=bug_report.md)
- **Feature** → [feature request](https://github.com/tortuvshin/grove/issues/new?template=feature_request.md)
- **Docs** → [documentation issue](https://github.com/tortuvshin/grove/issues/new?template=documentation.md)

## Security

**Do not file a public issue.** Follow [`SECURITY.md`](./SECURITY.md) — email **toroo.byamba@gmail.com**.

## Commercial / enterprise support

Grove is an MIT-licensed community project. There is no paid support tier, SLA, or private Discord. If you need a custom adapter, a migration from an existing directory, or hands-on help adopting Grove inside a larger org, open a discussion and we'll see what we can do.

## Maintainer response time

This is a small, part-time project. We aim to:

- Acknowledge new issues within **3 working days**.
- Triage (label + first reply with a question or "looking at it") within **7 days**.
- Ship a fix or follow-up plan for confirmed bugs within **30 days**, sooner for security issues.

If your issue is stuck, a polite bump is fine. If it's been silent for a month and blocking you, the pragmatic answer is usually "open a PR" — the diff doesn't have to be polished.
